__doc: Floors per model for the share of PR-summary checks passed (run.js --gate), as ratios. With no floor for a model, the gate reads the contract alone (routing, posting, composition), where any failed check fails it; the diff check reads the model's prose and is reported, not gated, until the model has a floor calibrated from runs.
eval-fake (the wiring smoke, every PR): the contract only (the scripted text speaks of no diff, so that check runs on real models). Deterministic: every check passes.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-15 from 2 local runs on the branch's base (main 4b5c881cd's summary path), 69 and 69 of 69. A binomial SE is 0 at 100%, so the floor leaves room for 2 failed checks of 69; below it the nightly confirms with a second run. The same run with the diff removed from the summary prompt scored 63 of 69: the three cases whose title says nothing (fix, wip, address review comments) went wrong.

2026-10-16: the diff check runs only where at least three words are the diff's own. On the Friday check, kimi-k2.7-code failed it on the tax-rounding case, whose only such word is `rate`; a good summary can miss a single word. The case keeps its other checks, so a run now has 68. deepseek on that change: 68 of 68; with the diff removed from the summary prompt, 64 of 68 (below the floor): the three vague-title cases and the CSV-export one. The floor still leaves room for 2 failed checks.

2026-10-16: each case now runs production's summary step (UpdateCommentsAndGenerateSummaryStage with the real CommentManagerService), with the review's comments the stage passes (lineComments, prLevelCommentResults) and the org's model routed by production's PermissionValidationService; the routing check reads the model off the call, and the stage's generate/post decision is three more cases (summary off, commit NONE, commit with summary off) instead of a stubbed check. A run has 105 checks. eval-fake: 94 of 94. deepseek: 105 and 105 of 105; with the diff removed from the summary prompt, 102 of 105 (replace-fresh and the two vague-title cases fix and address review comments). floor = (105 - 2) / 105 rounded down, the same room of 2 failed checks as before, so that break is below it. With prSummary routed to codeReview on purpose, the routing case fails on eval-fake (the call went to the config's default model).

2026-10-16, cloud route: the model now comes from the org's cloud route (evals/shared/model-route.js) instead of the self-hosted env route (applyModelEnv); on deepseek the request bodies are identical but for reasoning_effort, which the env route sent as high and the managed route leaves unset. Two runs on it: 105 and 105 of 105. The floor stands.
RATCHET: a PR that adds cases or moves the value on purpose recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.
